draft.emotion: attentive and leaning in close to catch a soft sound
notes: Feminine by convention (as a paired body part) despite having no feminine ending (-a). Dual: أُذُنَانِ; broken plural: آذَان.
Also pronounced and vocalized as أُذْن (/ʔuðn/).

senses.definition: The organ on the side of the head that people and animals use to hear.

examples.text: وَضَعَ يَدَهُ عَلَى أُذُنِهِ لِيَسْمَعَ جَيِّدًا.
examples.translation: He put his hand to his ear to hear well.
examples.emotion: focused and straining to hear a distant noise

draftBefore.emotion: attentive and leaning in close to catch a soft sound
notes: أُذُن is a feminine noun, so adjectives and pronouns describing it take feminine forms.
It can also refer to the handle or lug of a pot or cup, much like 'ear' in English.
